Direction: 01 — Pop-comic crush. Choices are three clean comic strips with large numbered lozenges; selected flirty reply pops outward subtly. Small illustrated reaction sticker of Lukey winking. Prioritize cheeky comic timing, punchlines, graphic impact. Not superhero combat UI.
